name: Next.js 15+ + Supabase + shadcn/ui
note: Each task runs a real vitest command. The Supabase client, next/headers and next/cache are stubbed at the module boundary, so the suite runs offline with no Supabase instance or PostgreSQL. The stub records the query-builder calls, so tests assert the exact .eq('user_id', ...) filters the actions build. RLS is checked by parsing the real migration SQL, not by executing it: no Postgres means policy enforcement itself is not exercised. next build is not run. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Zod schema is strict
eval_tasks.instruction: Server Action payloads must be validated by a strict schema that rejects unknown keys such as user_id.
assertions: short and over-length fields are rejected
unknown keys (user_id, is_completed) are rejected rather than stripped
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/schema.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Server Actions scope every query to the session user
eval_tasks.instruction: Every action must authenticate first and filter by the session user id, with owner taken from the session.
assertions: create inserts user_id from the session, ignoring a smuggled one
toggle, delete and list filter by user_id
unauthenticated calls never reach the database
database error text is not returned to the client
revalidatePath runs after a successful write
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/actions.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite covering RLS migrations, service-role key isolation, cookie flags and session verification from security/checks.json.
assertions: RLS-01/02: RLS enabled and auth.uid() = user_id policies with WITH CHECK, no USING (true)
RLS-03: service-role key has no NEXT_PUBLIC_ name and appears in no source file
AUTH-01: SameSite=Lax and production Secure are forced on session cookies
AUTH-02/03: middleware and page use getUser(), not getSession()
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security.test.ts

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete schema, action and security suite must pass with no failures.
